title: DCP Odd-Prime Modulus Z_p vs. Dyadic Z_{2^t} CNOT Zero-Sum Carry-Shift Obstruction
claims: Over any odd prime modulus p >= 3, gcd(2, p) == 1 implies tilde_A(v, x_0) == A v (mod p) holds for all x_0 in {0,1}^K iff A_{.,r} == 0 (mod p) for all r in supp(v).
For any minimal (subset-sum-free) zero-sum witness A v == 0 (mod p) of weight h, tilde_A(v, x_0) == 0 (mod p) holds on an exact 2^{-(h-1)} fraction of anchors.
